iso_a3.label: geography.location.country_code
iso_a3.why: The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (GBR, FRA), or Natural Earth's ADM0_A3 for the three countries ISO gives none. Inferred, finetype labels it an IATA airport code, since airport codes are also three capitals; it is a country code.

iso_a2.label: geography.location.country_code
iso_a2.why: The country's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (GB, FR). Inferred it is already a country code; nominated so that a sample that reads otherwise on a later build does not move it.
